$comment: Single source of truth for brand color. Consumed by tokens.css and validated by scripts/check-contrast.mjs. Edit here, not in CSS.

accent.$comment: Gold. Reserved for premium signals: featured badges, certified tags, price emphasis. Never for body text.

darkSurface.$comment: Luminance ladder. Each step is a measurable jump, with a faint green undertone so neutrals read as intentional rather than dead grey. Steps are wider than they look because contrast ratios compress badly near black — validated by check-contrast.mjs, not by eye.

focus.$comment: Focus rings are a dedicated token, never a border color. They must clear 3:1 against every surface they can land on.
